diagnosis: Customer on unified auth needs to rotate a potentially leaked scoped API key per kb-0003. Startup plan with basic support, 48h SLA. No escalation needed—this is a standard how-to request.
reply: Because your account uses Unified Auth, you can rotate the compromised key directly without affecting other credentials. Create a replacement scoped key with the same permissions, update your services to use it, then revoke the previous key immediately—revocation takes effect right away with no grace period. You can manage this from the API Keys section of your dashboard.
